qc.label_under_test: A piece partway through an extreme verdict, good or bad, before the rest of it arrives: an inner chunk of an intense judging adjective or adverb that is split into several tokens, mainly because it is written in ALL CAPS or broken by a hyphen (INCREDIBLE, FABULOUS, HORRENDOUS in caps; extra-ordinary; Russian замечательный); the opening word of a praise compound or idiom (first-rate, top-notch, world-class, state of the art, out of this world, show-stopping); and ' nothing' right after is/was opening a verdict (was nothing special, is nothing short of). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase (incredible, spectacular, magnificent arrive as one token), on plain superlatives (the best I have ever seen), on literal uses of the openers (the top of the hill, around the world, the state of Ohio), on ' nothing' after a comma or in literal uses (nothing left in the cupboard), and on neutral words in caps or split (RECTANGULAR, CALIFORNIA, photosynthesis).

neighbours.label: A piece partway through an extreme verdict, good or bad, before the rest of it arrives: an inner chunk of an intense judging adjective or adverb that is split into several tokens, mainly because it is written in ALL CAPS or broken by a hyphen (INCREDIBLE, FABULOUS, HORRENDOUS in caps; extra-ordinary; Russian замечательный); the opening word of a praise compound or idiom (first-rate, top-notch, world-class, state of the art, out of this world, show-stopping); and ' nothing' right after is/was opening a verdict (was nothing special, is nothing short of). Quiet on the same judging words spelled normally in lowercase (incredible, spectacular, magnificent arrive as one token), on plain superlatives (the best I have ever seen), on literal uses of the openers (the top of the hill, around the world, the state of Ohio), on ' nothing' after a comma or in literal uses (nothing left in the cupboard), and on neutral words in caps or split (RECTANGULAR, CALIFORNIA, photosynthesis).
fire: The concert last night was absolutely INCREDIBLE from start to finish.
Honestly, that hotel room was HORRENDOUS and I want my money back.
She looked FABULOUS in that red dress at the gala.
His performance in the final scene was extra-ordinary, the kind you remember for years.
The service at this little bistro is first-rate, and the desserts are even better.
They hired a top-notch team of engineers to rebuild the bridge.
The museum boasts a world-class collection of Impressionist paintings.
The new lab is equipped with state of the art microscopes.
quiet: Honestly, that hotel room was the worst I have ever stayed in and I want my money back.
She looked magnificent in that red dress at the gala.
His performance in the final scene was the best I have ever seen on that stage.
The service at this little bistro is spectacular, and the desserts are even better.
We hiked to the top of the hill to watch the sunrise over the valley.
The museum displays paintings collected from around the world.
The new lab is located in the state of Ohio near the river.
That chocolate cake was gone by noon, so I had none.

predictions: Blind test (label-only author). Expect hold: caps/hyphen verdicts strongest; first-rate / world-class openers weakest (~0.2 in probes).
